**CRITICAL semantics warning for Validator: football-data does NOT publish true opening odds. Its non-closing columns are Friday-afternoon (weekend games) / Tuesday-afternoon (midweek) snapshots — do NOT label them "opening".**

### Independently verified sample rows (2018/19, from live file)
- `E0,11/08/2018,Bournemouth,Cardiff,2,0,H` — pre-closing: B365 1.90/3.60/4.50, Pinnacle 1.89/3.63/4.58, WH 1.91/3.50/4.00; closing: Pinnacle 1.88/3.61/4.70 (PSCH/D/A); Bet365 closing & WH closing ABSENT for this season.
- `E0,19/08/2018,Man City,Huddersfield,6,1,H` — pre-closing: B365 1.10/13/26, Pinnacle 1.10/12.39/32.70, WH 1.06/12/29; closing: Pinnacle 1.08/13.93/36.05.

### True OPENING odds verdict: BLOCKED (no public verifiable row-level source)
- oddsportal.com: historically carried opening/closing, now behind Cloudflare/bot protection — could not verify from public fetch. BLOCKED.
- soccerpunter.com: has opening-odds movement history but gated to Platinum members (paywall) — verified from page text: "odds movement consisting of the opening odds history ... available exclusively to Platinum Members". BLOCKED (paywall).
- Pinnacle official: historical odds archive API exists but requires a paid API key. BLOCKED (auth/paywall).
- Private Excel database of Pinnacle open+close (sportsbookreview forum) exists but is private contact-based, not publicly verifiable. NOT USABLE.
- Conclusion: **Bet365/Pinnacle/WH 1X2 opening and Bet365 OU opening are unavailable in verifiable public row-level form for all four seasons. Do NOT substitute football-data pre-closing for opening.**

## Q2 — Matching keys, timestamp semantics, duplicate/conflict notes
- Keys: season (folder yy yy), Date (dd/mm/yy), Time (hh:mm, except 2018/19 where the column is absent — cross-reference against a fixture source for 18/19 kickoff times), HomeTeam, AwayTeam. Team naming stable across seasons ("Man United", "Man City", "Nott'm Forest", "West Ham", "Newcastle", etc.).
- Timestamp semantics: Date is match date (local UK); Time = kickoff (UTC varies with BST; verify per match before solar-time computation). **2018/19 has NO Time column — kickoff times unavailable in this file for 380 matches.**
- Duplicates/conflicts: each file is one row per fixture; no duplicates observed in sampled rows. Conflicts between bookmakers are intentional (different market snapshots) — report all, never merge.
- Coverage expectation: 380 fixtures per completed season (20 teams × 38 rounds); verified files begin at season openers (1819: 10/08/2018; 2122: 13/08/2021; 2425: 16/08/2024) and 2526 runs through 30/08/2025 at last check (season in progress, ~6 rounds). Exact row counts not line-counted this pass — deferred to Validator.

## Q3 — 2018/19 Cardiff City and Huddersfield Town: identity, PL entry season, venue
- **Cardiff City FC** — PL competition-entry season for the relevant stint: **2018/19** (automatic promotion as 2017/18 Championship runners-up, 90 pts; promotion sealed 6 May 2018, 0–0 vs Reading; previous PL stint 2013/14, one season, relegated 2018/19). Sources: ESPN/PA Sport (https://www.espn.ph/football/story/_/id/37553405/cardiff-city-premier-league-promotion-best-job-career-neil-warnock), fourfourtwo (https://www.fourfourtwo.com/news/championship-review-cardiff-promoted-bolton-leave-it-late-survive), shoot.co.uk (https://www.shoot.co.uk/cardiff-city-promoted-to-the-premier-league-on-the-final-day-of-the-2017-18-championship-season/amp/). Venue: **Cardiff City Stadium** (home since 2009; confirmed current ground via playmakerstats: https://www.playmakerstats.com/team/cardiff-city/2591?epoca_id=153). Coordinates (unofficial sources only): 51.472778, -3.203056 (GeoHack/Wikipedia-derived: https://geohack.toolforge.org/geohack.php?pagename=List_of_EFL_Championship_stadiums&params=51_28_22_N_3_12_11_W_type:landmark_scale:3000_region:GB&title=Cardiff+City+Stadium); also 51.4733/-3.2064 (zestate.co.uk property listing) — conflicting minor variants, reported not merged.
- **Huddersfield Town AFC** — PL competition-entry season: **2017/18** (club's first-ever PL season; won 29 May 2017 Championship playoff final 4–3 on penalties vs Reading; first top flight since 1971/72; 2018/19 was their second consecutive PL season, relegated). Sources: Sportsnet/AP (https://www.sportsnet.ca/soccer/huddersfield-wins-soccers-richest-game-premier-league/?sn-amp), ESPN (https://www.espn.ph/football/story/_/id/37523490/huddersfield-premier-league-everything-need-know), Wikipedia 2017 playoff final page (secondary). Venue: **John Smith's Stadium** (official name Kirklees Stadium; "John Smith's" name used 2012–2025; home since 1994). Coordinates (unofficial sources only): 53.654221, -1.769226 (https://www.latlong.net/place/the-john-smith-s-stadium-huddersfield-uk-31657.html) vs 53.65417, -1.76833 (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galpharm_Stadium) — conflicting minor variants, reported not merged. Naming lineage: Alfred McAlpine Stadium (until 2004) → Galpharm Stadium (2005–2012) → John Smith's Stadium (2012–2025) → Accu Stadium (2025+).
- Club registration lineage (deep): NOT researched this pass (out of feasible scope; entered unresolved queue).

## Q4 — Strict crosswalk verdict (case_id + complete pre-match qimen_output.json)
- **NOT sufficient for strict use**: true opening odds are unavailable for all four seasons, and an O_INTERVAL-style strict opening→closing interval cannot be constructed from any verifiable public source. football-data pre-closing values must NOT be passed off as opening.
- Closing-only crosswalk: feasible for 2021/22, 2024/25, 2025/26 (Bet365 + WH + Pinnacle closing); for 2018/19 only Pinnacle closing; 2018/19 also lacks kickoff times in the source file.
- Pre-match fields (date, teams, venue) are available; exact kickoff time for 2018/19 needs an additional fixture source.
